items.title: Repository README is accurate and safely executable
items.description: Verify @repo-readme contains the actual project entrypoint information, inventory every shell command, and use @seed-evidence-scripts to exercise safe real CLI paths only in disposable repository and user-home locations.
items.method: Reuse npm test as the shared test producer, then run node seed/scripts/verify-readme.js from the repository root. The verifier classifies every README shell command, rejects unknown command forms, and executes representative project, genome, verification, named-Seed, and skill-installation paths under a temporary repository, HOME, CODEX_HOME, and CLAUDE_HOME that it removes in a finally block. Network/global-install, placeholder, interactive pager, and terminal evidence-transition examples are inspected but not executed.
evidence_required: Exact npm test and README verifier commands with exit statuses.
Confirmation that repository files and real user skill homes were unchanged.

## Project Summary

### Metadata

_Source: `seed/seed.yml`_

Defines the as-built Seed document model, reusable genome compiler, constructed blueprint and diff views, executable verification ledger, and unpublished npm package and portable-skill distribution surfaces.

**Name:** seed-lang

**Summary:** Public-source Node.js CLI and contract language for authoring, composing, inspecting, diffing, and verifying Seed software contracts.


## Global Policies

### Readme Command Accuracy

_Address: `constraints.readme-command-accuracy` · Source: `builtin:repo-readme`_

Commands shown in the README are current, executable from their documented context, and checked against the repository.

**Policy:** global

### Explicit License Choice

_Address: `constraints.explicit-license-choice` · Source: `seed/seed.yml`_

The repository owner selected the MIT terms recorded in @repo-license; implementation work must not infer or replace that license.

**Artifacts:**
- repo-license

**Policy:** global

### License Metadata Consistency

_Address: `constraints.license-metadata-consistency` · Source: `seed/seed.yml`_

The root package.json and root package entry in package-lock.json declare MIT, matching the authoritative MIT terms in @repo-license. README and source files are not license-declaration surfaces in the as-built product.

**Artifacts:**
- repo-license
- package-manifest
- dependency-lock

**Policy:** global
